intro: Check what you sent in the chat, give it a title and choose a request type. A draft is made for you to check, edit and send yourself in the next step.
textHeading: What you sent in the chat
textNone: No text: only photos were sent
textPurged: The text was removed after the retention period
textTruncated: The text was longer than can be kept, so only its start was kept
textReference: This text is for reference only and is not sent with the request
imagesHeading: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} from the chat
imagesFailed: Photos that could not be fetched are not attached. Take or attach them again on the request page.
title: Title
titleHint: Taken from the first line of the text; you can change it, up to 200 characters
noTypes: No request types are switched on yet. Contact your administrator.
sendLater: Nothing is sent yet: you check, edit and send it for approval yourself on the next page
drafted: A request draft was made from this chat
dismissed: This chat draft is closed. Its text and photos are removed after the retention period.
expired: This chat draft expired because it was not used. Send a new message in the chat, or start from the request types.
listLine: {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} · {images, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · last {time}
untitled: Draft from the chat (no text yet)
notFound: This chat draft was not found. It may be someone else's or removed.

errors.title: Enter a title before making the draft
errors.type: Choose a request type before making the draft
errors.closed: This chat draft is closed. Open this page again.
errors.notFound: This chat draft was not found
errors.signIn: Your session has ended. Open it from LINE again.
errors.other: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.typeUnavailable: This request type can no longer be used. Open this page again and choose another type.
errors.noDepartment: Your account has no main department yet, so it cannot make a request. Contact your administrator.

imagesPending: Photos still being fetched are attached to the request draft when they arrive
